scripts.check: bun run format && bun run lint
scripts.api:dev: cd api && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bun run --hot index.ts
scripts.api:build: cd api && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bun build index.ts --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.api:start: cd api && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bun run index.ts
scripts.api:seed: cd api && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bun run scripts/seed-countries-cities.ts
scripts.web:dev: cd web && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bunx astro dev --port 2010
scripts.web:build: cd web && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bunx astro build
scripts.web:preview: cd web && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bunx astro preview --port 2010
scripts.admin:dev: cd admin && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bunx vite dev
scripts.admin:build: cd admin && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bunx vite build
scripts.admin:preview: cd admin && bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- bunx vite preview
scripts.mobile:start: cd mobile && RCT_METRO_PORT=2030 bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- expo start --port 2020
scripts.mobile:android: cd mobile && RCT_METRO_PORT=2030 bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- expo start --android --port 2020
scripts.mobile:ios: cd mobile && RCT_METRO_PORT=2030 bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- expo start --ios --port 2020
scripts.mobile:web: cd mobile && RCT_METRO_PORT=2030 bun --env-file=/dev/null ../packages/envless/src/Inject.ts -- expo start --web --port 2020
scripts.mobile:eas:build:android: cd mobile && eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.mobile:eas:build:ios: cd mobile && eas build -p ios --profile production
scripts.mobile:eas:build:android:dev: cd mobile && eas build -p android --profile development
scripts.mobile:eas:build:ios:dev: cd mobile && eas build -p ios --profile development
